dct_title_s: King County, Washington : Olympic Pipe Line
dct_description_sm: Abstract: Olympic Pipe Line Company right-of-way through King County, Washington.

Purpose: To create a thematic representation with limited attributes for incorporation within a GIS on behalf of OPLC depicting the company's pipeline right-of-way alignment through King County, Washington, USA.
